Girdwood Housing and Economic Committee
                              Sept 9, 2026
            Work Session RE Housing RFP & Regular Meeting
                              Minutes Final
         6 p.m. via Microsoft Teams & Girdwood Community Room

This hybrid meeting is taking place via Microsoft Teams & at the Girdwood Community Room, 250 Egloff Rd:

All committees of the GBOS operate under the Girdwood Public Meetings Standards of Conduct.

Call to Order 6:00 p.m. Krystal Hoke, co-chair
Roll Call
Attending are Krystal Hoke, Brooks Chandler and Matt Schechter. Tim Cabana
Meeting became a work session focused on the Housing Study RFP when quorum was not met.
Meeting became regular meeting when Tim Cabana joined at 6:45PM

Agenda Revisions and Approval
Sept 9 2026 WS re Housing RFP

GBOS report: GBOS GHEC Liaison: Kellie Okonek
TIPS funding request was forwarded to MOA with some minor adjustments
GVSA budget was approved by GBOS and forwarded to MOA.

Announcements/Presentations:

PUBLIC COMMENT:  None

Old Business:
     1.  Housing Study RFP update and follow-up (Kelley)
Group reviews RFP draft
This is different than construction/design/parks that staff and MOA have most experience with.
Timeline will be adjusted once RFP is closer to being posted.
Evaluation Criteria reviewed and recommendations noted.
Review of tasks and recommendations noted
OMB has advised that the cost will likely be greater than budgeted currently.
Cost will be negotiated through process after contractor is determined by RFP.
Funding will be the responsibility of GBOS

     2. GHEC Advance the Housing Policies from the GCP-
        POLICY H4.4: Develop an appropriate property tax incentive program to implement in Girdwood
    •   Resident tax incentive at the MOA now: consider recommending this to GBOS even if the property value
        threshold is unlikely in Girdwood
    •   Consider change in state law to support Workforce Housing, which is not specifically called out in state law.
    •  Exempt property converted from short-term to long-term rental.
    •   Consider proposal for different tax rate for second homes; ie homes not used as primary dwelling. NYC uses
        Excise tax. Would need to determine how to direct those funds to support local Girdwood housing.
    •   Consider Low income rental exemption, allowed in State law, requires Anchorage Ordinance. This could be an
       avenue for a developer to receive exemption. Also possible that a developer could be considered a tax exempt
        charitable organization, ie GCLT.
Eventually GHEC could make specific recommendations for GBOS to pursue with MOA.
Brooks will prepare motions for future meetings.

6:46PM Meeting is called to order as a regular meeting.

New Business:
     3.  Holtan Hills HOA Bylaws (to open discussion). No information at this time. This topic opens the discussion for
         future meeting. GHEC is interested in seeing HOA Bylaws proposed for Holtan Hills.

        Meeting Agendas and minutes are available: Municipal Road Maintenance Service Areas gbos-hes

                                                                                         1

4.  Shift meeting date to WED monthly through December (Oct 7, Nov 4, Dec 2). Item is considered for a vote
       due to time constraints. Change in date resolves conflict for Krystal Hoke.

Motion:
GHEC Moves to hold meetings on WED through December.
Motion by BC/2nd TC
Motion carries by assent.

Program Updates:
     5.  Reports from Subcommittee groups:
        Workforce Housing Definition group (Schechter/Hoke): KH and MS have reviewed and provide draft. Input
         received, item will move to new business at the next meeting. See meeting packet.

       RFP draft language for Orca Mtn View Subdivision land disposal (Chandler/Eker/Yelle) Meeting scheduled for
       mid-Nov with HLB. Brooks and Erin will meet prior.

     6.  Update on housing projects under way, if any
        Resort Daylodge parking lot condo development is in process with Planning and Zoning. Sewer and water
       have been extended to lot. Site plan review of 4 plex and 6 plex condo buildings.

        State DOT has approved lease for airport land development. Lease requires construction in 5 years or
       becomes void. Permit granted requires conditions of traffic study and NEPA, as requested by community.
         Hotel as aviation use is the crux of debate about MOA building permit.

     7.  Parcels requested for transfer:
          6-076: Across Karolius, adjacent to California Creek Park (to GCLT)
          6-039: Along Alyeska Highway/Across Ruane Road from the Industrial Park: Working on land transfer.
           6-011(C): Formerly 6—016;6.5 acre portion only within Holtan Hills now GIP.
          6-134: Across Karolius from 6-076. This parcel is under consideration for the RV park (to GPR). Update of
           proposal for feasibility study for RV Park to 35% design. Updated for TIPS

     8.  Discuss any updates to program matrix and data collection on short-term housing (Schechter)
       STR data from MOA registration. Preliminary data released. Deadline for registration is Oct 1.
Link to information is, some information is not publicly available, such as if the owner is on site. This could be shared
